newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae holder group backs new meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae holder group backs new meeting.

text.p: A shareholder group of Student Loan Marketing Association Tuesday said Institutional Shareholders Services Inc, the largest U.S. institutional shareholder advisory firm, recommended that shareholders support the group's call for a special shareholders meeting.

The group, the Committee to Restore Value at Sallie Mae (CRV) includes eight Sallie Mae directors. At the special meeting, shareholders will vote on a CRV proposed reorganization plan as an alternative to the plan of reorganization proposed by Sallie Mae, and will vote on who should be named to the reorganized company's board.

We "think shareholders should take this opportunity to maximize their right to choose who will implement the business strategy of the privatized Sallie Mae ... We recommend that shareholders sign and return the CRV's green agent designation card to call for a special meeting of shareholders," ISS said in a report to clients on a separate vote on naming the reorganized company's board.

Commenting on the differences between the CRV's plan of reorganization and the company's plan, ISS said, The "company and its shareholders would best be served by ... a special meeting in which shareholders can support the concept of reorganizing Sallie Mae as a private company, as contemplated by the Privatization Act, while separately voicing an opinion on the directors who will provide the company's leadership and direction."
